# FPSOT fees specification

> What software must record and prove about each fee that a public body charges under a law: fee schedules as dated parameters, with the indexation step behind each indexed value and the rounding rule; quotes as decisions with their lines and exemptions; fee orders and payment attempts with eight one-way statuses, set only after a read at the provider; refunds, remissions and disputes as separate records, where only a decision makes a remission; verified provider notifications and events with no personal value; sealed receipts; and payouts matched line by line to the cent. Card data never enters the software.

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, conformance classes, legal status, owners of the parts and conformance; FEE-001 to FEE-006.
- [Jurisdiction profiles](spec/en/profiles.adoc): FEE-010 to FEE-014.
- [Schedules and quotes](spec/en/schedules-and-quotes.adoc): FEE-020 to FEE-030.
- [Orders and payments](spec/en/orders-and-payments.adoc): FEE-040 to FEE-051.
- [Refunds, remissions and disputes](spec/en/refunds-and-remissions.adoc): FEE-060 to FEE-069.
- [Provider notifications and events](spec/en/notifications.adoc): FEE-070 to FEE-076.
- [Receipts](spec/en/receipts.adoc): FEE-080 to FEE-085.
- [Reconciliation](spec/en/reconciliation.adoc): FEE-090 to FEE-095.
- [Interfaces, adapters and conformance](spec/en/conformance.adoc): FEE-100 to FEE-105.
- [Alignment with other standards](spec/en/alignment.adoc): informative.
- [Questions for counsel](spec/en/questions-for-counsel.adoc): informative, not legal advice.
